answer: Make pay a zero-sum duel. Each epoch a beacon pairs every seat with a random rival; both stake 1 token (assumed), answer the same task, and a blind panel picks the winner, who takes both. Identity count buys nothing: two clones drawn together just move a token from one pocket to the other, and against honest rivals each copy must truly win. A farm of 500 weak clones bleeds about 250 tokens an epoch, a river flowing to better agents. No atlas of IPs needed; weak copies bend like willow and pay.
